name: DA-EPOCH-R (Dose-adjusted Etoposide + Prednisone + vinCRIStine + Cyclophosphamide + DOXOrubicin + Rituximab)
histology: diffuse large B-cell / high-grade B-cell lymphoma (e.g., MYC/BCL2 double-hit) and primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma

biomarkers.MYC: MYC rearrangement (double-/triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma) is a common reason DA-EPOCH-R is chosen, but is not itself a dosing gate
biomarkers.note: Rituximab requires CD20 positivity (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, lines 253 to 254, 566). DA-EPOCH-R is favored in MYC-rearranged / high-grade B-cell lymphoma and primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma (DeVita lines 268807 to 268815, 123847). Dose adjustment is by prior-cycle neutrophil nadir, not by biomarker.

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for previously untreated aggressive B-cell lymphoma (high-grade B-cell lymphoma / double-hit and primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: previously untreated aggressive CD20-positive B-cell lymphoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, line 4158 (DA-EPOCH + Rituximab); line 4426 (Dose-adjusted EPOCH + Rituximab, DLBCL); DeVita line 123847 and lines 268716 to 268727 (DA-EPOCH-R de facto standard for these patients)

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY for EPOCH-specific value: DeVita gives only a generic etoposide range of 50 to 100 mg/m2/day (line 14891); the EPOCH continuous-infusion 50 mg/m2/day value is not printed as such.

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. DA-EPOCH etoposide (conventionally 50 mg/m2/day continuous infusion, days 1 to 4, dose-adjusted upward by cycle) is not printed as an EPOCH-specific value; DeVita's generic etoposide range is 50 to 100 mg/m2/day (line 14891). Verify starting dose before activation.

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. DA-EPOCH prednisone (conventionally 60 mg/m2 PO twice daily, days 1 to 5) is not printed in the extracts. Verify dose, basis and schedule before activation.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 10.1 (antineoplastic drug reference), Vincristine entry, lines 20760 to 20761: 0.4 mg/d continuous infusion for 4 d (the EPOCH-type continuous-infusion schedule, distinct from the 0.5 to 1.4 mg/m2/wk IV bolus with a 2 mg cap).

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 10.1, lines 20760 to 20761: vincristine 0.4 mg/day by continuous infusion for 4 days (the EPOCH continuous-infusion schedule). The table prints 0.4 mg/day WITHOUT /m2, so basis is encoded as flat per the literal source; the widely cited DA-EPOCH value is 0.4 mg/m2/day, so the BSA-vs-flat basis should be verified against the primary regimen source. A 2 mg per-dose ceiling is recorded per the ONCQIS vincristine safety invariant and is non-binding at this 0.4 mg/day continuous-infusion dose (the classic 2 mg cap targets the weekly IV bolus schedule). ISMP tall-man vinCRIStine.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY for EPOCH-specific value: DeVita gives only a generic doxorubicin range of 30 to 75 mg/m2 q3wk (lines 19634 to 19635); the EPOCH continuous-infusion 10 mg/m2/day value is not printed.

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. DA-EPOCH doxorubicin (conventionally 10 mg/m2/day continuous infusion, days 1 to 4) is not printed in the extracts. Anthracycline: track cumulative lifetime dose (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2). ISMP tall-man DOXOrubicin. Verify before activation.

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.locator: Harrison line 385777 (rituximab 375 mg/m2 once a week for 4 weeks) and line 120283 (usual dose 375 mg/m2 on day -1 before chemotherapy); DeVita line 323457.

drugs.notes: Source: Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457. Rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1. Requires CD20 positivity; infusion-reaction premedication and HBV screening before anti-CD20 therapy.

supportiveCare: G-CSF: required as part of dose-adjusted EPOCH (supports the dose-escalation schedule).
Dose adjustment: escalate the etoposide/doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide doses each cycle by prior-cycle neutrophil (and platelet) nadir per the DA-EPOCH algorithm.
HBV screening and reactivation prophylaxis before anti-CD20 (rituximab).
Tumor lysis syndrome prophylaxis for high tumor burden; CNS prophylaxis per CNS-IPI / risk.
Avoid concurrent high-dose methotrexate with DA-EPOCH (unacceptable toxicity, Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, line 4351).

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle and to guide dose adjustment
cumulative anthracycline dose tracking (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2)

doseModificationRules.text: Adjust doses of etoposide, doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide up or down each cycle per the DA-EPOCH nadir-based algorithm; clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: DA-EPOCH-R discussion lines 268716 to 268727, 268807 to 268815; vincristine continuous-infusion Table 10.1 lines 20760 to 20761; generic etoposide (line 14891) and doxorubicin (lines 19634 to 19635) ranges; rituximab 375 (line 323457)

guideline.locator: line 4158 (DA-EPOCH + Rituximab), line 4426 (Dose-adjusted EPOCH + Rituximab), line 4351 (avoid concurrent high-dose methotrexate); CD20 lines 253 to 254, 566

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for DA-EPOCH-R in aggressive B-cell lymphoma (#75). Two components are dose-grounded: vincristine 0.4 mg/day by continuous infusion for 4 days (DeVita Table 10.1, lines 20760 to 20761; note the table omits /m2, so basis is encoded flat and the BSA-vs-flat basis should be verified; recorded with a non-binding 2 mg per-dose ceiling per the ONCQIS safety invariant (0.4 mg/day continuous infusion never reaches it)), and rituximab 375 mg/m2 day 1 (Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457). Four doses are set to VERIFY because the DA-EPOCH-R starting-dose table is not printed in the provided extracts: etoposide (conventionally 50 mg/m2/day CIV days 1 to 4; DeVita generic range 50 to 100 mg/m2/day at line 14891), prednisone (conventionally 60 mg/m2 PO twice daily days 1 to 5), cyclophosphamide (conventionally 750 mg/m2 IV day 5), and doxorubicin (conventionally 10 mg/m2/day CIV days 1 to 4; DeVita generic range 30 to 75 mg/m2 q3wk at lines 19634 to 19635). Regimen role and the caution against concurrent high-dose methotrexate are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026 (lines 4158, 4426, 4351). Doses are dose-adjusted each cycle by prior-cycle marrow nadir with mandatory G-CSF. ISMP tall-man applied (vinCRIStine, DOXOrubicin); anthracycline cumulative cap 450/550 mg/m2. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
